description: Create a quiz. Prefer sending themeDescription or themeCustomization so the saved quiz has a custom visual theme; if omitted, the server derives one from the title/description. Omit backgroundMusicId to use default YouTube-safe shared background music, or set null for silent. Required: title. Optional: description, format, quizType, template, countdownSeconds, difficulty, musicVolume, and questions[].

backgroundMusicId.description: Background music track id from /api/v1/music. Omit to use the default YouTube-safe shared track; set null for silent.

countdownSeconds.description: Seconds of countdown shown before each question (3–15).

description.description: Optional longer description shown on the quiz page.

difficulty.description: Target difficulty level for the generated/created quiz.

format.description: Output aspect ratio: "tiktok" (9:16 vertical) or "youtube" (16:9 horizontal).

musicVolume.description: Background music volume from 0 (silent) to 1 (full). Default 0.15.

questions.description: Optional initial questions with their answers and images.

answers.description: Answer options for this question; exactly one should be marked isCorrect=true.

additionalInfo.description: Optional explanation or trivia shown after the answer is revealed.

isCorrect.description: Whether this answer is the correct one for the question.

order.description: 1-indexed display order of the answer within the question.

ttsText.description: Optional exact narration line for the answer reveal.

duration.description: Seconds viewers have to answer this question (must be >= 1).

imagePath.description: Optional primary image URL shown with the question (used by picture_guess quizzes).

images.description: Additional images attached to the question (in addition to imagePath).

alt.description: Alt text describing the image for accessibility.

sourceUrl.description: Original attribution URL for the image, if any.

url.description: Absolute URL of the image asset.

order.description: 1-indexed display order of the question within the quiz.

questionText.description: The question prompt shown to viewers.

ttsText.description: Optional exact narration line for this question.

quizType.description: Quiz mechanic: multiple_choice, reveal_answer, or picture_guess.

themeCustomization.description: Explicit custom theme to save and apply to the quiz. Invalid colors/fonts are ignored by the API sanitizer.

description.description: Optional natural-language source description for the custom theme.

fontFamilyOverride.description: Approved font family used for question and answer text.

name.description: Optional saved theme label, e.g. "Golden Theme".

themeDescription.description: Natural-language custom visual theme prompt. Example: "golden luxury game show", "ocean glass", or "cyber neon". The server saves the generated themeCustomization and applies it automatically.

name: quiz_video_create_quiz
title: Create a quiz
